title: ceanothus dentatus subsp. floribundus
intro: Ceanothus dentatus subsp. floribundus, commonly known as California lilac or bluebells, is a shrub-like plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, and may aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ceanothus dentatus subsp. floribundus include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
